title: C++: Circuit Breaker
description: Implement the Circuit Breaker pattern with CLOSED, OPEN, and HALF_OPEN states.

steps.title: Circuit Breaker Implementation
steps.description: Create a CircuitBreaker class with states CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN. Track failure count, threshold, and timeout. Implement bool call(function) that returns false if circuit is open. Automatically transition to HALF_OPEN after timeout.
hints: enum class State { CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN };
call: if open, return false. If half_open, try once then transition based on result.
If closed and failure >= threshold, transition to open.
